description: List the costs recorded in your workspace, newest first: what each was for, its amount, currency and the agent or customer it belongs to. Filter by customer_id and by start_date and end_date, and page with limit and offset. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

customer_id.description: The customer: its id, as it shows in your workspace.

end_date.description: The end of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

limit.description: How many to return. Defaults to 100.

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next page.

start_date.description: The start of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

name: list_costs
